reader2_rulings.item: 1a advisor.open (verb 'sorun' read as the noun 'problem')
reader2_rulings.reason: Defect removed: a homograph first-parse failure on the most visible string of the batch, named by BOTH independent readers (reader 1 item 1, reader 2 item 1), each recovering the imperative only on a second look. My earlier rejection rested on two grounds; both fall. (1) Length: the 14 in the brief is a target, not a limit; verified in src/components/Advisor.astro: .adv-fab is display: inline-flex with min-inline-size 84px and no fixed or maximum width (line 592), and below 640px the text span is hidden (lines 633-635); the published ru label has 17 characters, the new tr label 16. (2) 'The dative clears the noun reading inside the word group': two readers out of two did not clear it at first sight, so the argument is refuted by the evidence the stage exists to collect. None of the four rejection grounds of 07-judge.md applies (no fact added, no Arabic distinction erased, no tm pair for this key, no termbase entry overruled). 'danışın' is the polite plural imperative of danışmak (siz, UI1-controls), governs the same dative (Bulbul'a), has no noun or other homograph, is reader 2's own proposal, echoes 'danışman' in the panel title (ar 'مستشار'), and repeats a form already in tm ('937'ye danışın'). 'Ask' rendered as 'consult' stays inside the source: the one asked is the advisor. Weighed and not chosen: 'Bulbul'a sor' (sen; no site-wide precedent for sen on tr controls); 'Bulbul'a soru sorun' (19 characters and still carries 'sorun'); 'Bulbul'a yazın' (changes ask to write, and 'yazın' is itself a homograph: tm has 'mağaralar yazın serin' = in summer); 'Bulbul'a sorunuz' ('sorunuz' = your question).

The genitive is not added: the indefinite compound 'Visit Al-Ahsa danışmanı' is the normal Turkish title form ('X danışmanı') and the proofread passed it; no reading failure is named, only a preference.

reader2_rulings.item: 10 advisor.close ('Kapatın': formal; what closes is not said)
reader2_rulings.reason: Form: closed, UI1-controls; identical to the published tr lang.suggest.close 'Kapatın'. Object: the source is bare ('إغلاق' / 'Close'), and the button sits inside a panel that is role=dialog labelled by the heading (Advisor.astro line 109, aria-labelledby=advisor-title), so the thing closed is announced by the dialog; 'Sohbeti kapatın' would say the chat ends, while the conversation is kept in sessionStorage (lines 155-156). Edited spot E2: no further edit. Both readers asked the same question, so it is logged for the owner as a source matter.

reader2_rulings.reason: Reader: understandable. The source says 'محادثة جديدة' / 'New conversation' and nothing about clearing; 'Sohbeti temizle' is sen and is not the source's word. Edited spot E3: no further edit. Both readers raised it: logged under source_defects.

reader2_rulings.item: 14a advisor.resting ('dinleniyor' first parsed as 'is being listened to')
reader2_rulings.reason: Defect removed: 'dinleniyor' is both dinlenmek (to rest) and the passive of dinlemek (to be listened to). Reader 2 took the passive first and gave the mechanism: the subject is a songbird ('bülbül dinlenir'). Reader 1 did not stumble on the word. Applying the rubric, not the head count: the wording is free (no closed ruling, no tm pair, no termbase entry) and replacing it meets none of the four rejection grounds, so the observation is applied. Weight on the merits: this is the line shown when the helper is unavailable, where both readers were already slow to grasp the state, and in a chat panel that carries a privacy notice the passive also reads as 'is being monitored'. This is a different remark from reader 1 item 14, which asked to spell out 'service unavailable' and stays rejected. New wording 'Bulbul şu an molada.': 'mola' is a pause taken to rest, so the bird is still resting/on a break in the persona's voice (ar 'يستريح الآن', en 'is resting right now'); no reason invented, no promise of return, 'şu an' kept; 'molada' (mola + -da after a back vowel) has no second reading. Weighed and not chosen: 'dinlenmede' (reader's proposal: headline register, same root); 'dinlenme molasında' (unambiguous but heavy for the persona); 'dinlenmeye çekildi' (drops 'now', literary); an explicit error statement (replaces the owner's line with a fact it does not state). Sentence 2 of the string is untouched.
reader2_rulings.before: Bulbul şu an dinleniyor. Gezilecek yerlere ya da “Gezinizi planlayın” sayfasına göz atabilirsiniz.
reader2_rulings.after: Bulbul şu an molada. Gezilecek yerlere ya da “Gezinizi planlayın” sayfasına göz atabilirsiniz.

reader2_rulings.reason: The asymmetry is the source's ('تصفّح المعالم أو صفحة «…»' / 'the attractions or the “Plan your trip” page'); 'Gezilecek yerlere … göz atın' is the published tr plan.empty.browse phrasing. No reading failure named.

reader2_rulings.item: 14d advisor.resting (when the helper comes back is not said)

reader2_rulings.item: 15a advisor.rate ('sizi bekliyor' sounds like a brochure) — edited spot E5
reader2_rulings.reason: A medium remark on an edited spot is ruled here without further edits (07-judge.md). On the merits: it renders ar 'بين يديك' / en 'all yours'; reader 1 rejected the earlier 'emrinizde' as servile, and its own alternative 'göz atabilirsiniz' would repeat advisor.resting word for word. The promotional shade is real and is counted in the nativeness score.

reader2_rulings.item: 15b advisor.rate (semicolon unusual in a chat bubble)
reader2_rulings.reason: The semicolon is the English source's and is correct Turkish punctuation; one reader, a preference, no reading failure. An edit here would remove no defect.

reader2_rulings.item: 15c advisor.rate (how many questions; 'bu arada')
reader2_rulings.reason: The number is not in the source (source matter, logged; nothing invented). 'bu arada' is the role's 'meanwhile'; reader: 'yanlış değil'.

reader2_rulings.item: 16 advisor.error
reader2_rulings.reason: Reader: understandable, ordinary error message. The playful/plain contrast with advisor.resting is the source's (ar 'تعذّر الوصول إلى بلبل' is impersonal too), as ruled for reader 1 item 16. Checked: 'Bulbul'a ulaşılamadı' does not depend on the wording of advisor.open.

reader2_rulings.item: general (three voices: playful, dry-formal, polite-imperative labels)
reader2_rulings.reason: The three voices are three functions of the source (persona bubbles, notice and error, control labels); the label form is UI1-controls (closed).

notes: [s7a] Score 93 = judge.json 92 with nativeness 27 → 28: the two first-parse failures (sorun, dinleniyor) are removed. Nativeness is held at 28 by reader 2's remaining remarks, all kept: the promotional shade of 'sizi bekliyor', the formal ring of the -in labels (closed UI1-controls), the mixed-script title (closed brand rule). Accuracy unchanged at 28: 'danışın' and 'molada' stay inside the source's meaning (ask the advisor; resting right now), no fact added or dropped. Threshold 90 (config.json pass_threshold, re-read for this addendum): 93 ≥ 90.

[s7a] This addendum EDITS two keys, so 07-judge.md requires, before merge, a fresh proofread and a FRESH blind reader on the edited spots: advisor.open ('Bulbul'a danışın') and advisor.resting sentence 1 ('Bulbul şu an molada.'). Checklist for the fresh reader: is 'danışın' read at once as an invitation to ask the helper; does 'molada' read at once as 'not available now, resting' with no second meaning. The score stands for the text as written and has not been tested by that reader yet.

[s7a] Mechanical points checked by me on the two new strings only: apostrophe U+0027 in 'Bulbul'a'; dative -a after the back vowel u; 'danışın' = danış + -ın (back unrounded harmony); 'molada' = mola + -da (vowel-final stem, back vowel); quotation marks U+201C/U+201D in advisor.resting untouched; no digits, no Markdown. 'Bulbul'a danışın' has 16 characters (the brief's target was 14; see ruling 1a for why the target does not bind).

[s7a] No other key follows the change of advisor.open: advisor.error ('Bulbul'a ulaşılamadı'), advisor.placeholder ('Sorunuzu yazın…'), advisor.rate ('soru sınırı') and advisor.title ('danışmanı') were read against it and stay byte for byte.

[s7a] Batch ruling ADV-1, FINAL wording for the termbase (replaces the wording proposed in judge.json): «The advisor's action labels follow UI1-controls (Gönderin · Kapatın · Yeni sohbet başlatın). The floating button is 'Bulbul'a danışın' (polite plural, 16 characters; the 14-character figure of the brief is a target, the button has no fixed width and hides its text below 640px). 'Bulbul'a sorun' is rejected: two blind readers out of two first read 'sorun' as the noun 'problem'; 'sor' is sen; 'yazın' is itself a homograph. A short visible label must not end in an imperative that is also a common noun or adverb (sorun, yazın). The unavailable-service line is 'Bulbul şu an molada.', not 'dinleniyor' (dinlenmek / passive of dinlemek, read as 'is being listened to' with a songbird as subject). The notice names Bulbul as the subject of its first sentence and keeps 'saklanmaz'.»

[s7a] Closed rulings not reopened: 'Bulbul' (termbase brand), 'Visit Al-Ahsa' beside 'El-Ahsa', 'Cebel el-Kare', the published label 'Gezinizi planlayın', UI1-controls. No open_items touched. termbase_additions: none (no new proper name).
[s7a] Not done in this addendum: no build, no git, no edit to termbase.json, tm.json or scores.csv (the coordinator's), no change to judge.json.
source_defects: advisor.chip3: en 'Hasawi food' deviates from ar 'المطبخ الأحسائي' (and from the site rule «الأحسائي» not «الحساوي»); en should read 'Al-Ahsa cuisine'. tr follows ar + nav.food 'El-Ahsa mutfağı'.
advisor.intro: en 'Hala!' is weaker than ar 'يا هلا والله!' (hearty welcome); tr follows ar.

Owner, for confirmation only (no change made): the Turkish reader again stumbled on the Latin 'Bulbul' against Turkish 'bülbül' (nightingale). The termbase ruling stands (Latin brand, as en/de, already raised by the emergency batch 2026-11-15); listed so the owner sees a second reader on it.

Owner, for information (reader 2, no change made): the fresh reader also took 'Bulbul' for a misspelt 'bülbül', and both readers read 'Al-Ahsa' (brand, title) and 'El-Ahsa' (place name) as two spellings of one place. Both rulings are closed and stand.

advisor.notice: the source names 'Anthropic' with no word on what it is; both Turkish readers did not know the name. Whether the notice should say what Anthropic is belongs to the owner (all languages); tr adds nothing.

advisor.notice / advisor.rate: the notice says the questions are 'not stored' while a daily question limit is counted; reader 2 asked what exactly is not stored (the text of the questions, or the count). The source does not say; tr renders it as given ('Sorular … saklanmaz').
advisor.rate: the source does not say how many questions the daily limit is (reader 2). Nothing invented.
advisor.resting: the source does not say when the helper is available again (reader 2). No time may be promised; nothing invented.

advisor.reset: the source label 'محادثة جديدة' / 'New conversation' does not say that the current conversation is erased; both Turkish readers missed that information on a screen-reader-only label. tr follows the source.
advisor.close: the source label 'إغلاق' / 'Close' does not name what is closed; both Turkish readers asked. tr follows the source (the button sits in a dialog labelled by the panel heading).

advisor.intro: the last line invites the visitor to 'tell me what you like', while the three chips under it are ready-made questions, not likes (reader 2: the link is loose, not confusing). Source/layout matter.

final_strings.advisor.title: Bulbul, Visit Al-Ahsa danışmanı
final_strings.advisor.intro:
Hoş geldiniz, sefalar getirdiniz! 🐦🌴
Ben Bulbul, El-Ahsa'nın her hurma ağacını tanırım.
Şöyle bir dolaşmaya mı geldiniz, yoksa yalnızca buralıların bildiği yerlerin peşinde misiniz? Nelerden hoşlandığınızı söyleyin, keyfinize göre bir gezi ayarlayayım.
final_strings.advisor.notice: Bulbul yalnızca sitenin içeriğine dayanarak yanıt verir. Sorular Anthropic'in hizmeti üzerinden işlenir ve saklanmaz.
final_strings.advisor.resting: Bulbul şu an molada. Gezilecek yerlere ya da “Gezinizi planlayın” sayfasına göz atabilirsiniz.
final_strings.advisor.rate: Bugünkü soru sınırına ulaştınız. Yarın görüşmek üzere; bu arada gezilecek yerlerin sayfaları sizi bekliyor.
final_strings.advisor.error: Bulbul'a ulaşılamadı. Lütfen birazdan yeniden deneyin.
final_strings.advisor.chip2: Cebel el-Kare ne zaman açık, giriş ücreti ne kadar?
